vars.label: Net migration, ages 10 to 19 in 2020, 2010-2020 (estimate, % of expected)
vars.ref: Estimated by the observatory: the 2010 and 2020 census counts by municipio, age and sex (Census Bureau estimates files, census bases) and Puerto Rico's life table (UN WPP 2024), by the residual method (netmig_age.py)
vars.definition: Net migration between the 2010 and 2020 censuses of the people aged 10 to 19 in 2020 (aged 0 to 9 in 2010), per 100 of the people of that age the municipio would have had with no migration: positive, more came than left; negative, more left. An estimate by the residual method: the 2020 census count of each age group minus the survivors of the same people in the 2010 census, by sex, with Puerto Rico's life table (UN World Population Prospects 2024, 2010-2019). It counts moves to and from the rest of Puerto Rico and abroad together, net; errors in either census land in it, and in small municipios a few hundred people can move the figure.
